request.style: English, celtic, male solo voice with deep resonance, solo, bodhran, tin whistle, harp, fiddle, cello, somber and reflective, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior
Son of a prostitute, Gilead his father
His half-brothers drove him out of the house
You will inherit nothing, they told him in anger

[Verse]
He fled to the land of Tob in exile
Worthless men gathered around him there
When Ammonites made war against Israel
The elders came back to him with care

[Chorus]
If you give the Ammonites into my hand
Whoever comes out of my door shall stand
Belonging to the Lord in sight
I will offer him up in the light

[Verse]
Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah
He crossed Gilead, advanced against them
The Ammonites were subdued in defeat
Twenty towns struck down, a crushing weight

[Chorus]
If you give the Ammonites into my hand
Whoever comes out of my door shall stand
Belonging to the Lord in sight
I will offer him up in the light

[Bridge]
His daughter met him with tambourines and dancing
Her only child, no son or daughter
He tore his clothes and cried in pain
I opened my mouth to the Lord, in vain

[Outro]
She wept in the hills for two months
A custom in Israel, year after year
The daughter of Jephthah, remembered in grief
A hero of faith, a sorrowful fear
